n: APLC Computer Science Unplugged Kindergarten and Grade 1
t: Ten paper-based computer science lessons for Kindergarten and Grade 1.
steps: Find the unit PDFs and the K-1 resource pack on the APLC site.
Download the Kindergarten or Grade 1 unit.
Download the resource pack and watch the videos on paper grids and turn arrows.
Print the student pages for the first lesson.
Gather playing cards and grid mats.
Read the scripted teacher guide for Lesson 1.
Teach the lessons in order and use the Grade 1 assessment to check sequencing.
